schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Everything non-major across the workspace packages — one weekly PR.

Dev tooling gets its own PR but does NOT automerge, same reasoning as the contract repositories (CAN-1422 review): a green CI cannot catch a malicious release, because postinstall runs at install time, before any test asserts anything. Here the stake is higher still — this is the published SDK, so a compromised build tool ships to consumers.
